issues.explanation: Here it is part of the historical title 中山靖王, not Zhongshan City in Taiwan or a modern place-name entry.
issues.suggested_fix: Use “Zhongshan” and gloss it as the historical Zhongshan title/kingdom.

issues.explanation: In 织席, 席 means a mat or woven mat, not the surname Xi.
家贫 means “the family/household was poor”; the dictionary-reference gloss is unrelated.
In 七尺五寸, 尺 is a traditional unit of length, roughly a foot, not a gongche music character.
issues.suggested_fix: Gloss as “traditional unit of length; foot.”

issues.explanation: 曾 means “once; formerly” here, not the surname Zeng.
从郑玄、卢植求学 means studying under/with Zheng Xuan and Lu Zhi; the variant-character reference is not useful.
看榜 means “read/look at the notice or posted list,” not “look after.”
听见后 means “after hearing it”; 后 is not a surname here.
与他 means “with him”; the gloss referring to 欤 is unrelated.
共举大事 means “undertake/carry out a major undertaking,” not the unrelated variant-character entry.
车 in 推车 is the noun “cart/vehicle,” not a particle.
投军 means “join the army,” so “to throw” materially misleads the learner.
关羽 is a personal name and should be kept together; splitting it makes 羽 look like the ordinary noun “feather.”
issues.suggested_fix: Use one name segment: 关羽, Guān Yǔ, “Guan Yu.”

issues.explanation: 也 means “also” here, not the surname Ye.
三人 begins with the numeral “three,” not the surname San.
桃园 in 桃园结义 refers to a peach garden, specifically the story’s Peach Garden, not Taoyuan City in Taiwan.
祭天 means “perform a sacrifice to Heaven”; the surname gloss is unrelated.
In 祭天, 天 means Heaven/the heavens, not “day.”
同心 means “with one heart; united in purpose” in this vow, not a place name.
issues.suggested_fix: Type as word and gloss “with one heart; united.”

issues.explanation: In 救国, 国 means “the country,” not the surname Guo.
In 安民, 安 is the verb “to bring peace to; pacify,” not the surname An.
issues.suggested_fix: Gloss as “to pacify; bring peace to.”

issues.explanation: 民 means “the people” in 安民, not a personal name.
issues.suggested_fix: Type as word and gloss “the people.”

issues.explanation: 匹 is the measure word used for horses here; “matching” is not the local function.
和 links the quantities “five hundred liang of gold and silver and one thousand jin of refined iron”; it means “and,” not the surname He.
投在刘焉麾下 means “join/come under Liu Yan’s command,” not “throw.”
issues.suggested_fix: Gloss as “to join; come under the command of.”

issues.explanation: 在刘焉麾下 expresses being under Liu Yan’s command, not “to exist.”
issues.suggested_fix: Gloss as “under; in the service of.”

issues.explanation: 侄 means “nephew” here; merely identifying it as a character variant hides the useful contextual word.
